lineage.strategy: Seek a materially different commercial-channel source rather than repeat consolidated financial evidence.

observations.fact: IBM announced a joint go-to-market partnership with OpenAI, embedding frontier models and Codex/ChatGPT Work into IBM Consulting Advantage and launching a dedicated OpenAI Practice with thousands of consultants and engineers.

The announced focus spans financial services, government, telecommunications and retail plus finance, procurement, customer operations and HR workflows, broadening IBM Consulting's addressable AI implementation surface.

risks.risk: The announcement provides no contract value, bookings, revenue contribution, margin economics or customer conversion rate, so commercial impact remains unquantified.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental revenue, bookings, attach rates and margins attributable to the OpenAI Practice are not disclosed.

recommendation: Use as current execution/distribution evidence for enterprise AI delivery; do not translate the partnership into numeric economics without separate sourced results.
